name: CreatorMemBench v1.0
description: CreatorMemBench v1.0 contains 20 synthetic creator timelines and 160 checkpoints for evaluating mutable long-term memory in creator agents. The benchmark covers stable identity, scoped preferences, multi-session composition, transient noise, updates, forgetting, retention, and resurrection. The archive includes separated inputs and gold criteria, a strict semantic scoring protocol, an offline aggregation script, a prediction schema, a license, and SHA-256 checksums. It contains no production conversations, account identifiers, credentials, proprietary service code, endpoint identifiers, or raw internal traces.
